SHIVAM KEJRIWAL Software Development Engineer 3 – Information Security

PROFILE SUMMARY











Bringing around 4 years and 7–8 months of hands-on software development experience, with specialized focus on secure system design, distributed backend architectures, and cloud-native microservices. Serving as SDE 3 – Information Security at Innovaccer, leading design and development of security- focused microservices, APIs, multi-tenant platforms for large-scale healthcare SaaS products. Capability to engineer event-driven security platforms that sunk production vulnerabilities by combining automated remediation workflow, real-time threat-detection services, and virtual-patching pipelines. Designed and applied IAM services, WAF orchestration layers, and multi-cloud security governance systems that integrate with 50+ SaaS/cloud platforms and back > $200K in annual internal savings. Recognized for building AI-driven developer-productivity tools (secure-coding assistant, RFP chatbot), architecting safety systems for generative AI platforms, mentoring engineers on secure system architecture, and embedding security-by-design into the SDLC.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Innovaccer, Inc. – Noida, India | Software Development Engineer 3 – Information Security December 2025 – Present Software Development Engineer 2 – Information Security (January 2025 – November 2025)









Designed and rolled out an AI guardrails layer for the Gravity AI platform, adding protections such as prompt-injection defenses, clinical intervention filters, hallucination controls, and bias checks using fine-tuned BERT-based SLMs and rule-driven validators to make generative AI safe for clinical workflow. Built and operationalized Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect with Wazuh & IBM QRadar, enabling structured log parsing, correlation, automated alerting; applied 28 custom MCP functions for advanced time-windowed searches & IOC-driven detections, boosting SIEM correlation speed & visibility. Led the complete security re-architecture and backend modernization for four acquired products, rewriting >10,000 lines of legacy PHP microservices into FastAPI, migrating them to Innovaccer’s IAM, logging, and multi-tenant security stack, and defining compliance alignment patterns across the portfolio. Backing secure-by-design practices for newly onboarded engineering teams by running threat-modeling workshops, establishing secure code-review practices, and guiding architecture decisions around multi-tenant data isolation and identity flows.

Software Development Engineer I – Information Security | July 2022 – December 2024













Engineered a federated IAM microservices platform integrating with 50+ SaaS and cloud applications; designed REST APIs, token flows, and event-driven identity lifecycle workflow, eliminating third-party IAM tools and enabling just-in-time access while saving around $120K annually. Architected and deployed a centralized password-management microservice built with Python, FastAPI, and Redis; designed async APIs, distributed caching logic, and rate-limiting strategies to handle 1 million concurrent authentication requests with sub-100ms latency, backing multi-tenant user authentication across healthcare SaaS products. Engineered an automated WAF rule-management and infrastructure pipeline for orchestrating Cloudflare security policies at scale; authored 500+ custom WAF rules and designed rule schemas, deployment workflow, and CI/CD integrations enabling product teams to safely deploy and test custom security policies while maintaining enterprise baselines. Built a real-time configuration-drift detection and rollback service using AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, and event streams; designed it to monitor infrastructure changes across AWS and Azure and automatically revert unauthorized updates within about 5 seconds for 1,000+ events, cutting MTTR. Designed a virtual-patching orchestration pipeline that connects vulnerability scanners, security advisories, and incident systems; modeled remediation workflow as event-driven microservices, bringing open production vulnerabilities down from 15,000 to 50 over 8 months via faster, automated remediation cycles. Developed a multi-cloud security governance service that ingests around 250,000 security data objects per day from ~70 sources, normalizes them, and runs rule-based analytics to surface 500+ high/critical vulnerabilities monthly, contributing to about $80K in yearly operational savings.

AI/ML Security  Fine-tuned BERT-based SLM models,

prompt injection prevention, hallucination detection, bias detection, rule-based validators, LLM safety frameworks Compliance & Governance  SOC 2, HIPAA, HITRUST, MARS-E,

NIST 800‑53, FedRAMP

Risk assessment, data privacy and

security governance

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) – Nov 2025 Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ- 500) – Sep 2025 Pursuing: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) – expected completion December 2025

EDUCATION

B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering The LNM Institute of Information Technology, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India | 2022 | CGPA: 8.52

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages Known: English, Hindi Location: Noida, UP







Created an AI-powered secure-coding assistant using generative AI and Git commit history; designed data pipelines, LLM integration, and training-scenario generation to embed secure-coding knowledge into developer workflow, refining secure-coding efficiency by ~80% and cutting SAST-detected issues by ~75% in onboarded teams. Developed an LLM-based chatbot for security questionnaires and RFPs leveraging large language models and vector embeddings; engineered context-retrieval systems, prompt optimization, export routines, reducing manual response time per 52-question RFP from ~250 minutes to under 3 minutes while maintaining 98% contextual accuracy. Contributed to Innovaccer's move from single-tenant to secure multi-tenant architecture by helping design tenant-isolation models, granular RBAC policies, and schema strategies for shared services, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and HITRUST standards.

INTERNSHIP

Software Development Engineer Intern – Information Security | January 2022 – June 2022







Assisted in building security microservices and dashboards that braced application and infrastructure security across the healthcare platform. Researched emerging attack patterns and incorporated findings into design references for new services. Tested and validated security tools and services before production rollout, documenting behavior, failure modes, and operational runbooks. Helped create a security monitoring dashboard offering near real-time visibility into vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across cloud accounts.

Innovaccer, Inc. – Noida, India | Software Development Intern – Platform Engineering May 2021 – August 2021



Aided platform engineering team in designing & deploying backend microservices & deployment tooling. Developed a Schema APIs microservice that serves as the central schema generator for all databases during deployments, reducing infrastructure provisioning time by roughly 15% and being recognized as the best intern project among 35 ideas.

PROJECTS & RESEARCH



System and Method of Managing Security in a Multi-Cloud Environment (Patent) – Filed with USPTO and the Indian Patent Office in January 2024; aggregates around 250,000 unique data objects per day from about 70 sources, applies rule-based analysis, and issues alerts for potential vulnerabilities.



Rainfall Estimation and Prediction Using Artificial Intelligence (Research Paper) – Presented at Congress on Intelligent Systems 2021; published in Lecture Notes on Data Engineering & Communication Technologies, vol-111, Springer, Singapore, DOI: 978-981-16-9113-3-59.



Spatial & Temporal Analysis using Deep Neural Network (Research Paper) – Led spatial–temporal rainfall analysis using 21 weather parameters and a dataset of about 200,000 rows from the PSL NOAA Climate Repository, achieving strong accuracy for moderate rainfall prediction in parts of Rajasthan.
